LocalSend core (Rust crate `localsend`), vendored for Oeca Nearby with the patches below.

Source:  https://github.com/localsend/localsend  (packages/core)
Commit:  26cc8f997aa3f7ad789c12500a8b7206cfbb3ddc  (2026-11-21)
Licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, from the repository root)

Vendored instead of a git dependency because the repository's Flutter
submodule cannot be checked out by Cargo on Windows (path length). Oeca
enables only the `webrtc` and `pem` features (see Cargo.toml).

Every file is identical to `git archive <commit> packages/core` plus LICENSE,
except two, changed by OECA-PATCHES.diff (lines marked `oeca:`), small enough
to propose upstream:

src/webrtc/signaling.rs
  1. Close the WebSocket when the client drops its sender, so the server
     drops the peer at once (no ghost peer until its 5-minute idle timeout).
  2. End the read loop after 180 s without any frame (the 120 s ping's pong
     included): a socket that died in sleep or a network change is noticed.
  3. A server that closes before HELLO (its per-IP limits) is an error, not
     a panic; the listener stops instead of panicking when its receiver is gone.
src/webrtc/webrtc.rs
  4. send_offer / accept_offer take an optional persistent DTLS certificate
     (a stable fingerprint is the peer identity Oeca verifies). API change:
     one new parameter.
  5. The peer connection is closed however a session future ends, including
     when the caller drops it (cancel, timeout, shutdown): no ICE / DTLS task
     or socket outlives the session.
  6. Failed and Closed connection states end a session, not only Disconnected.
  7. A declined transfer lets the DECLINED message leave before the
     connection closes (it could be lost before).
  8. send_offer takes an optional metadata gate, awaited after the connection
     is authenticated and before the file list: the caller can keep names,
     sizes and types from a peer it has not verified. API change: one new
     parameter. No wire change.
  9. Cancel reaches the other side at once: the data channel is closed before
     the peer connection (its SCTP stream reset is standard and understood by
     LocalSend Web), and a session ends when the remote closes its data
     channel (before: only when ICE gave up, about 5 s).
 10. An optional Extension per session: extra SDP lines, the peer connection,
     and data channels not labelled "data" (ignored before). API change: one
     new parameter. Oeca's verification handshake uses it; LocalSend's own
     messages are unchanged.
 11. Security: the caller is given the answer the session really applies
     (matched by session id), since any ANSWER message can claim a peer; SDP
     inflation is bounded to 64 KiB; an answer arriving after its session
     ended no longer panics the signaling listener.
 12. Security: a session's inner task is aborted when the session ends or is
     dropped. It was detached and kept its buffers and the connection.
 13. Security: a chunked control message (file list, token list) is refused
     above 1 MiB while it accumulates, before it is parsed.
 14. Security: a peer that opens more than 4 data channels in a session ends
     it (each costs a task and a 64 KiB buffer).
src/webrtc/signaling.rs
 15. Security: one signaling message is at most 1 MiB (64 MiB before).
src/webrtc/webrtc.rs
 16. send_offer reads one confirmation per file before it closes (it read one
     in all, so a receiver lost the last of several files), reads them while
     sending (unread, they hid the receiver's close), checks each id, and
     reads what is still queued when the receiver closes. Extension gains
     file_results, which hands them to the caller. No wire change. Tested
     at the end of webrtc.rs.
 17. Privacy: set_ip_filter lets the embedding app choose which local
     addresses are offered as ICE host candidates (all when unset, as
     before). No wire change.
